This tool will change how things happen from the field to the office. It will make everyone's lives easier and more fluid. Things will not be overlooked, tasks will not be forgotten, and actions will get handled and passed off to the appropriate person.

It is just a great tool when you have a service business where people are in the field and driving. They need to capture their thoughts and capture actions, and can't be writing them down or using apps and having to interact with them by touching them while driving.
